summary: Aura Minerals Inc. declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.72 per share (US$0.24 per BDR) totaling ~US$60.4 million, exceeding its Dividend Policy minimum of 20% of Adjusted EBITDA less sustaining and exploration capex. The dividend is payable August 28, 2026 to shareholders of record August 18, 2026; BDR holders paid ~September 8, 2026. CEO Rodrigo Barbosa also noted a new US$200 million share repurchase program. The filing is a routine dividend announcement under Form 6-K, representing a special-situation capital return to shareholders.
